api.description: Fetch an attachment of a message by partId (shown in messages.get with format full, or in a database search of messages fetched with format full) or attachmentId. Returns the file like Drive files.download: inline when small, otherwise saved by the host and returned as fileId

fields.description: partId of an attachment part, e.g. "1.2"; shown in messages.get with format full, or in a database search of messages fetched with format full. Give partId or attachmentId
Gmail attachmentId, if already known. Give partId or attachmentId; with partId, the part's own attachment is read.
The file, base64-encoded. Missing when the file came back as text or contentOmitted is set.
The file as text, in place of contentBase64, when it is a text file (CSV, JSON, Markdown, XML and the like) in UTF-8.
Media type of the file, for example application/pdf.
Size of the file in bytes.
The file name, when known.
Set when the content was left out: the caller did not ask for it, or the file was over the limit.

Where the host saved the file. Over the limit it comes in place of the content; a host that keeps every file sets it beside the content too. On Corsair it is a Files id (fil_…): pass it to another app wherever that app takes a file URL, or read a text file or PDF with files.read_text.

api.description: Search messages with structured fields (keywords, from, to, subject, after, before, hasAttachment, label, in, isUnread, ...) or a raw q; no Gmail syntax needed. Returns only id and threadId per message, no subject or body. Use messages.get to read one

fields.description: Same syntax as the Gmail search box, e.g. "from:alice newer_than:7d" or "after:2025/01/31 has:attachment". Optional: prefer the structured fields below; when both are given, a message must match both.
Words that must all appear in the message (AND logic)
Exact phrase that must appear in the message
At least one of these words must appear (OR logic, minimum 2 items)
Words that must not appear in the message
Words that must appear in the subject line
Sender: email address or name; several match any of them
Recipient in the To field: email address or name; several match any of them
Recipient in the Cc field: email address or name; several match any of them
Only messages sent on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
Only messages sent before this date (YYYY-MM-DD)
true: only messages with an attachment
Attachment file name or type, e.g. "report.pdf" or "pdf"
Label name (not id), e.g. "work". Spaces in a name are written as hyphens.

fields.type: inbox | sent | drafts | trash | spam | snoozed | anywhere
fields.description: Mailbox location; "anywhere" also searches spam and trash
true: only unread messages; false: only read messages
true: only starred messages; false: only unstarred ones
Bytes, or a number with a K, M or G suffix such as "5M"
Bytes, or a number with a K, M or G suffix such as "5M"
Defaults to 100, at most 500. Follow nextPageToken for more.
Label ids such as INBOX, UNREAD or Label_123, not label names; all of them must match. labels.list returns the ids.
Spam and trash are left out unless this is true.
